videos.title: Videos
videos.description: YouTube video ids or links. A bare 11 character id, a watch link, a youtu.be link, a /shorts/ link and an /embed/ link are all read.

maxVideos.title: Max videos
maxVideos.description: How many videos one run reads. The rest come back as free status rows with the reason maxVideos.

includeDescription.title: Include the video description
includeDescription.description: Add the description to every delivered row. It is the largest field, so it is off by default.
